details.description: Horlicks is India's #1 Nutrition Drink that helps kids be Taller, Stronger, Sharper. It contains 27 vital nutrients like Folic Acid, Vitamin D, Protein, Calcium, and Iron that help in mental development and physical strength. It also has Zinc and Vitamin E that build immunity. Regular intake of Horlicks with daily diet helps in children's growth and development like better bones, more muscles and improved concentration scores. For your favourite cup of Horlicks, just take 200 ml of hot or cold milk or water, add 3 spoons (27 g) of Horlicks, stir briskly, and enjoy! This iconic drink has been a household name for over a century, synonymous with nourishment and wellness. Today, Horlicks stands as a beacon of nutritional goodness, cherished by generations across the globe.

details.description:
Horlicks is a nutrition drink that contains nutrients to support immunity. Horlicks has been clinically proven to improve 5 signs of growth and to make kids taller, stronger, and sharper. It is also scientifically proven to improve the power of milk. Horlicks is now available in 4 exciting and delicious flavours - Classic Malt, Chocolate, Elaichi, and Kesar Badam. Enjoy with a cup of hot milk or a glass of cold milk. Horlicks is a leading force in the ‘Science of Food’ and has bio-available nutrients, meaning nutrients that are more available for growth. These get absorbed in the blood and are carried to all parts of the body.
Horlicks contains 9 nutrients (Vitamin B6, B12, C, D, Copper, Folic Acid, Iron, Selenium, and Zinc) which are scientifically proven to support immunity. It also increases the density of minerals such as calcium in bones to give children bigger and stronger bones. Horlicks is clinically proven to increase lean tissue, making children 'stronger'. It helps improve attention and concentration to make your child sharper. Horlicks is also clinically proven for more haemopoietic nutrients in the blood, leading to 'healthier blood', referring to improvement in the levels of blood health-related nutrients (Vitamin A & Folate) in circulation. Horlicks is also clinically proven to increase fat-free mass, making children stronger.

details.description: Horlicks, India's #1 Nutrition Drink, has been a household staple for over a century. Synonymous with nourishment and wellness, Horlicks has been a trusted companion in Indian homes, offering essential nutrients to families for generations. Now, we are excited to introduce the Horlicks Chocolate Milkshake - a rich, thick, and creamy chocolate-flavoured treat that is now available in a convenient and long-lasting tetra pack. This delightful beverage is perfect for those who crave a delicious and nutritious drink. Whether it's a hot summer day or a chilly winter evening, you can now indulge in the delectable taste of Horlicks Chocolate Milkshake all year round. The convenient tetra pack ensures that the milkshake remains fresh and ready to enjoy anytime, anywhere. Incorporate the Horlicks Chocolate Milkshake into your daily routine as part of a balanced diet and regular exercise plan to maximise its health benefits. This beverage not only satisfies your taste buds with its fantastic chocolate flavour but also provides essential nutrients that contribute to overall well-being. Enjoy the perfect combination of great taste and health benefits with every sip of Horlicks Chocolate Milkshake. For the best experience, serve this creamy, chocolatey delight chilled. Whether you're enjoying it as a refreshing pick-me-up during the day or as a tasty treat to unwind in the evening, the Horlicks Chocolate Milkshake is sure to become a favourite in your household. Embrace the new packaging and relish the timeless goodness of Horlicks in this exciting and delicious new form.

details.description:
Horlicks Lite is a specialized adult nutrition drink that caters to the unique nutritional requirements of active adults aged 35 and above. Horlicks Lite with no added sugar contains high-quality protein that helps in cell maintenance and repair, which is essential for maintaining a healthy body. Moreover, Horlicks Lite is free from added sugars and cholesterol, making it a perfect fit for older adults.
About Horlicks Lite: Nutrition designed for Active Adults. Horlicks adult contains essential nutrients like Vitamin C, Vitamin D, and Zinc that are known to support the optimal functioning of the immune system, promoting a healthy body. Lite Horlicks is with no added sugar. It contains six antioxidant nutrients, like Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Vitamin B2, Zinc, Selenium, and Copper, that protect cells from oxidative stress, ensuring the body's overall well-being. Horlicks Lite is a nutrition drink for adults is designed to support the healthy lifestyle of active adults and provides a maximum shelf life of 12 months. Add three heaped teaspoonfuls (25g) of the powder to 200ml of cold or hot milk or water to prepare your nourishing Horlicks Lite drink. Stir quickly to mix well and enjoy great taste of Horlicks Lite. Available in 2 tasty flavours - Regular Malt and Badam.

details.description:
Bones form the structural framework of the human body. Up until the age of 30, bone formation is faster than bone loss, which causes the skeleton to grow both in size and density, resulting in an overall increase in bone mass. After the age of 30, bone mineral density may start to decrease. Unfortunately, there are no visible signs of weak bones. They often go unnoticed over many years, with no symptoms or discomfort until a bone breaks. To maintain strong bones you don’t just need an adequate intake of Calcium, but also Vitamin D for Calcium absorption and Vitamin K2 for binding Calcium to bones, daily. Remember, Vitamin K2 is not commonly found in the Indian diet, and Vitamin D is not even available in your daily diet. Horlicks Women’s Plus is a bone nutrition specialist powered with CALSEAL formula. It provides 100% RDA^ of Calcium, Vitamin D & Vitamin K2 requirements.
NIH Osteoporosis and related bone diseases national resource center (https://www.bones.nih.gov/health-info/bone/bone-basics).
Ref: Malhotra N and Mithal A. Osteoporosis in Indians. Indian J med res 127, march 2008, pp 263-268
Unique combination of Vitamin K2, Calcium and Vitamin D to support bone health.
In 2 serves (60 g) as per ICMR 2010 Guidelines on Women.
Added sugar refers to Sucrose.'CONTAINS NATURALLY OCCURRING SUGARS'.
Horlicks Women’s Plus is a nourishing beverage to be consumed as a part of regular diet.

Horlicks Diabetes Plus is a nutritional beverage designed for Indian adults.
It is scientifically formulated to support the dietary management of at-risk
and diabetic individuals.
It contains high fibre (22%) with a dual blend of Fibresol-2 and Nutriose®^.
Research has shown that a diet rich in fibre helps reduce glucose and lipid
levels in the blood*. Horlicks Diabetes Plus is high in protein and contains 16
vital nutrients. These fibres are known to promote satiety and reduce calorie
intake.
Soluble dietary fibre, when taken as part of a balanced diet, contributes to
the reduction of blood cholesterol levels. The beneficial effect is obtained
with a daily intake of a minimum of 3 g of soluble dietary fibre.
Horlicks Diabetes Plus is not intended to replace any existing medication.
It is a nutritional beverage to be consumed as part of a balanced daily diet
and exercise routine.

Fibre Dextrin respectively.

calorie-conscious individuals.
